facts.text: Snow left Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) and Salt Creek Falls (4,220 ft) 42 to 43 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 29 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Salt Creek Falls
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 25 (2023), May 16 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) and Salt Creek Falls (4,220 ft).

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: 1.7 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 38.1 in (2023), 17.0 in (2024), 21.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Salt Creek Falls
evidence.detail: 1.1 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 35.5 in (2023), 20.8 in (2024), 20.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 20 and May 12, carried from the melt-out dates at Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) and Salt Creek Falls (4,220 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 293 ft below the pass; points to March 16 to May 3

evidence.name: Salt Creek Falls
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 1,003 ft below the pass; points to March 24 to May 21
